Title: Missing Spring Cloud Gateway Route for Staff Profile Endpoints
Workflow: Staff Login & Workspace Navigation (Admin, Courier, Dispatcher)
RootCause: GatewayRoutesConfig and application.yml lack route definition for /api/v1/staff/**
Impact: All requests to /api/v1/staff/me through gateway return HTTP 404, breaking staff profile loading in React frontend.
RecommendedFix: Add route locator in GatewayRoutesConfig and application.yml forwarding /api/v1/staff/** to accounts-service (:8081).
TestRequirement: GatewayRoutesConfigTest unit test + WebTestClient verifying /api/v1/staff/me route forwarding.
AcceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/staff/me through gateway (port 8080) forwards to accounts-service and returns 200 with staff profile.

Title: Gateway Java Route Fallback Port Defaults to Communications Service Instead of GraphQL Query Service
RootCause: Fallback value in @Value annotation uses port 8084 (communications-service) instead of 8085 (graphql-query-service).
Impact: If GRAPHQL_SERVICE_URL environment variable is unset, /graphql requests are forwarded to communications-service causing 404 errors.
TestRequirement: Unit test verifying default fallback URI for graphql-service route resolves to port 8085.
AcceptanceCriteria: GatewayRoutesConfigTest asserts target URI is http://localhost:8085 when property is unset.

Title: Authenticated Merchant Browser Session Missing merchant_id Tenant Claim in Keycloak JWT
Workflow: Merchant Web Portal Parcel Booking & Order History
RootCause: Keycloak token lacks merchant_id claim because merchant entity lives in accounts-service DB; delivery-service rejects requests without this claim.
Impact: Authenticated merchants using the React UI cannot create parcels (403 Forbidden) or view orders (empty list); only API key requests succeed.
RecommendedFix: Add Keycloak user attribute / protocol mapper or allow delivery-service to resolve merchant_id from subject UUID via internal lookup.
TestRequirement: Integration test with user JWT containing MERCHANT role verifying parcel creation and order retrieval.
AcceptanceCriteria: Merchant logged in via React SPA can successfully submit booking form and view their created parcels.

Title: Fake/Mock Bulk Order Intake in Merchant UI Discards Orders in Memory
RootCause: handleConfirmImport simulates import with setTimeout and calls onImportComplete without sending HTTP request to backend.
Impact: Merchants receive false confirmation that parcels were imported, but no parcels are created in delivery-service.
RecommendedFix: Implement bulk parcel intake API endpoint in delivery-service and connect frontend modal to perform real batch bookings.
TestRequirement: Vitest test with MSW verifying POST request is dispatched with parsed CSV rows.
AcceptanceCriteria: Uploaded CSV rows are persisted in delivery database and real parcel IDs are returned.

Title: Fake Webhook Test Ping in Merchant UI Simulates Mock Dispatch
RootCause: handleSendTestPing executes 700ms setTimeout and sets hardcoded fake HMAC signature without calling communications-service.
Impact: Merchants cannot verify webhook endpoint connectivity; UI displays misleading test results.
RecommendedFix: Implement POST /api/v1/merchants/webhooks/{id}/test in communications-service and invoke it from the UI.
TestRequirement: Unit test in communications-service for test ping dispatch + Vitest test for button click API call.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clicking Test Ping triggers backend webhook delivery attempt and displays authentic HTTP status and duration.

Title: GraphQL deliveryStats Resolver Missing, Surfacing gRPC UNAVAILABLE Error on Admin Reports
RootCause: ADR LATER_11 deferred deliveryStats gRPC provider in delivery-service; resolver throws Status.UNAVAILABLE.
Impact: Admin and Dispatcher reports pages display error notification banners on load.
RecommendedFix: Implement gRPC DeliveryStatsService in delivery-service or handle partial data gracefully in GraphQL resolver and UI.
TestRequirement: Integration test for deliveryStats GraphQL query returning aggregate counts.
AcceptanceCriteria: GraphQL query { deliveryStats { totalBooked inTransit delivered failed } } returns valid aggregated metrics.

Title: Gateway Route Conflict for Admin Pricing in application.yml
RootCause: application.yml routes /api/v1/admin/** to accounts-service without an explicit prior route for /api/v1/admin/pricing/**.
Impact: If YAML routes take precedence over Java RouteLocator, admin pricing calls fail with 404 from accounts-service.
RecommendedFix: Add explicit route for /api/v1/admin/pricing/** in application.yml before /api/v1/admin/**.
TestRequirement: Automated YAML route configuration validation test.
AcceptanceCriteria: Requests to /api/v1/admin/pricing/zones reliably forward to pricing-service (:8082).

Title: Monolithic Frontend JavaScript Bundle Chunk Exceeds Performance Budget (763 kB)
Workflow: Initial Application Load & First Contentful Paint
RootCause: All routes are imported synchronously; no React.lazy() code splitting or manual chunking configured.
Impact: Vite bundle warning (> 500 kB); slow initial page load for mobile users on public tracking screen.
RecommendedFix: Convert route page components to React.lazy() with Suspense fallback and configure manualChunks in vite.config.ts.
TestRequirement: npm run build verifying main bundle chunk is under 300 kB.
AcceptanceCriteria: Initial chunk is < 300 kB; feature chunks load on-demand when navigating to /admin, /merchant, etc.

Title: Unassigned Roles Redirection Loop and Dead-End on Callback Page
Workflow: User Authentication Callback for Users Without Assigned Roles
RootCause: CallbackPage redirects to /login if getDefaultRouteForRoles returns null; /login shows active session banner with no navigation.
Impact: Users without explicit roles are trapped in a dead-end state with no logout or support link.
RecommendedFix: Redirect users with unassigned roles to /unauthorized or an onboarding pending review screen with a clear logout button.
TestRequirement: Vitest test simulating user with empty roles array navigating through CallbackPage.
AcceptanceCriteria: User is shown clear informative status message with options to logout or contact administrator.

Title: SSRF Protection Missing IPv6 and Cloud Metadata Checks in WebhookDestinationValidator
RootCause: Validator checks standard IPv4 private ranges but omits cloud link-local (169.254.169.254) and IPv6 loopback/unique-local.
Impact: Potential Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability in cloud environments.
RecommendedFix: Perform full IP resolution check forbidding link-local, loopback, and IPv6 unique-local before storing or dispatching webhooks.
TestRequirement: Unit tests verifying rejection of 169.254.169.254, [::1], and [fe80::1].
AcceptanceCriteria: WebhookDestinationValidator throws InvalidDestinationException for all link-local and IPv6 internal addresses.

Title: Inconsistent CORS Configurations Between Edge Gateway and Microservices
RootCause: Edge gateway sets CORS headers while some downstream services also configure CORS independently.
Impact: Risk of duplicate Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers causing browser fetch failures.
RecommendedFix: Ensure downstream services only allow gateway origin or configure gateway to deduplicate CORS headers.
TestRequirement: Integration test checking preflight OPTIONS responses contain exactly one Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.
AcceptanceCriteria: Browser requests to any service via gateway receive valid, non-duplicated CORS headers.

Title: Missing Index on parcels.merchant_id in Delivery Service Database Schema
Workflow: Merchant Order Listing and Filter Queries
RootCause: V1 Flyway migration creates foreign key column merchant_id but does not create an index on it.
Impact: Full table scans when querying parcels for a merchant as the delivery database scales.
RecommendedFix: Add Flyway migration creating index idx_parcels_merchant_id ON parcels (merchant_id, created_at DESC).
TestRequirement: Flyway migration test verifying index creation and EXPLAIN plan using the index.
AcceptanceCriteria: Query plan for SELECT * FROM parcels WHERE merchant_id = ? uses index scan instead of sequential scan.

Title: Gateway Route Integration Suite Lacks Route Coverage for Staff and Admin Pricing Paths
RootCause: Unit test suite only tests customer and tracking routes; staff profile route was not included.
Impact: Routing bugs escape CI without warning.
RecommendedFix: Add parameterized route tests in GatewayRoutesConfigTest asserting destination for all declared REST routes.
AcceptanceCriteria: 100% of defined API gateway paths have automated route destination assertions.

Title: Python Integration Test Suite Skips Ingress Tests Without Local Mock Fallback
RootCause: Ingress tests skip when port 80 is not listening rather than running against local gateway port 8080.
Impact: Ingress and cluster routing tests are bypassed during normal local test executions.
RecommendedFix: Support SWIFTDROP_GATEWAY_URL environment variable to run ingress tests against localhost:8080 when k8s is inactive.
AcceptanceCriteria: 0 tests skipped when running against local gateway.

Title: Native window.alert() Used for File Upload Validation Error in Merchant Modal
Workflow: Merchant Bulk CSV File Drag and Drop
RootCause: Direct invocation of window.alert() violates WCAG 2.2 accessibility and UX guidelines.
Impact: Screen reader disruption, focus loss, and mobile browser modal lockup.
RecommendedFix: Replace alert() with accessible inline banner element using role="alert" and aria-live="polite".
TestRequirement: Vitest test checking inline alert message rendering when non-CSV file is dropped.
AcceptanceCriteria: No window.alert calls exist; invalid file displays accessible red error banner.

Title: Missing Visible Keyboard Focus Indicators on Custom Tracking Timeline Milestones
RootCause: Timeline milestone elements lack focus-visible CSS styling.
Impact: Keyboard users cannot visually distinguish focused timeline items (WCAG 2.4.7 violation).
RecommendedFix: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-500 focus-visible:outline-none to milestone interactive containers.
TestRequirement: A11y inspection checking tab navigation focus indicators.
AcceptanceCriteria: All timeline steps display high-contrast focus rings when navigated via keyboard Tab key.

Title: Root Build Instructions Mismatch with Independent Service POM Architecture
RootCause: Documentation describes a root Maven aggregator, but repository uses independent POMs per v1.3 architecture.
Impact: New contributors executing mvn clean install at repository root encounter missing pom.xml error.
RecommendedFix: Update PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md and README.md with instructions to build services via build-all.sh script or individual service directories.
TestRequirement: Verify all commands listed in README.md execute without error from clean checkout.
AcceptanceCriteria: Documentation accurately reflects independent build topology and zero cross-service coupling.
